newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Cedenco says succeeds in court case.
newsitem.headline: Cedenco says succeeds in court case.

text.p: Cedenco Foods Ltd on Thursday said it had been successful in court action on insurance claims, the positive effects of which were initially assessed to be approximately NZ$1.5 million in cash terms and $1 million in 1996/97 reported pre-tax earnings.

"Cedenco Foods has received a judgement from the High Court in relation to proceedings issued by it against State Insurance in 1993 for crop losses incurred in the 1992/93 season," Cedenco said in a statement.
"The High Court has made an award to Cedenco on some of its claims and declined others."
Cedenco said it was currently assessing the impact of the judgment and considering its options.
Its initial assessment of the positive effect of the judgment allowed for costs and other deductions.
